title: Velvety Sweet Potato Bowl
description: A simple and comforting sweet potato dish, topped with a variety of flavors.
instructions: Poke some holes in the sweet potatoes with a fork and roast for 45-50 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, mix the olive oil, zaatar, and salt in a small bowl.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, let them cool for a few minutes before slicing them in half lengthwise.
Spoon the velvety tahini over the top of each sweet potato, then sprinkle with the olive oil and zaatar mixture.
Serve immediately, garnished with a sprinkle of zaatar and a drizzle of tahini.
